answer: Let trust propagate on the attestation graph through bounded-length random walks, discounting transition mass at each step and weighting votes by resulting reachability. A Sybil cluster may be internally dense yet linked to honest identities by few edges, giving it low conductance. This sparse external cut limits walk flow across the boundary, so min-cut and transitivity bounds cap the cluster’s aggregate voting weight, even if shale, sable, and vine identities multiply within it.
